hits.title: Mutant Zone: Zombie Merge Fighter
hits.description:
Zombies are coming! Collect equipment and fight. Merge items, combine weapons! Upgrade your fighter and go into battle with a crowd of zombies. Guns and armor!

The world is captured by a dangerous zombie virus. Hordes of mutants have filled the streets of cities. Grab a machine gun and go into battle! Go through a dangerous path through many locations and clear the streets of zombies. Pick up cool equipment and combine weapons and armor. Assemble a unique fighter with cool abilities. Defeat various mutants, zombies and dangerous Bosses.
Defeat powerful bosses, look for treasure chests, capture enemy outposts!
Features of the game:
- Unique gameplay that combines merge, strategy, fighting and sandbox!
- Combination of items, weapons and armor
- Multifunctional character editor, you can assemble a unique character that will be only yours!
- Lots of different weapons, from bats and knives to grenade launchers, flamethrowers and plasma guns!
- Lots of cool locations, explore cities, factories, military bases, laboratories, etc.
- Dangerous enemies! An army of evil zombies, mutants, big bosses. Defeat them all!
Assemble your fighter and win!
hits.howToPlayText:
To win the level, you need to clear the location of zombies.
To increase the level of items - combine 2 identical items.
Controls:
To buy a loot box - press the button with the image of the loot box and the price tag.
To open the loot box - click on the loot box in the inventory.
To send a fighter into battle - press the "TO BATTLE" button
